questions.question: Before the Feast of Tabernacles, why did Jesus choose not to travel in Judea?

answers.text: The Jews there were trying to kill Him
Roman soldiers were out to arrest Him
Herod had sent men to capture Him

questions.question: Jesus' own brothers believed in Him. True or false?
Jesus told His brothers the world hated Him but could not hate them. Why did it hate Him?

answers.text: He testified that its works are evil
He took its crowds away from it

questions.question: After Jesus' brothers went up to the Feast of Tabernacles, how did Jesus go?

answers.text: Riding in on a young donkey
